about.title: Despre Verbologic
about.p1: Verbologic este o platformă decuplată de învățare a limbilor, cu scalare O(N): date de entități statice, audio livrat de la marginea rețelei, căutare instantă în client și un flux de lucru agentic dual-LLM.
about.p2: 532 de entități de română și engleză recuperate din traseele vechi sunt deja active în traseele căutabile.

lessons.title: Lecții

contrastive.letter_a: Like the a in father ; open and clear, not clipped.
contrastive.letter_a_breve: Like the unstressed u in but ; short central vowel.
contrastive.letter_a_circumflex: No exact English match; a central, unrounded vowel produced with the tongue higher in the mouth.
contrastive.letter_b: Like the b in bed ; voiced and direct.
contrastive.letter_c: Like c in cat before a/o/u , and like ch in chin before e/i .
contrastive.letter_d: Like the d in dog ; clean voiced stop.
contrastive.letter_e: Like the e in bed , but usually a bit steadier and more closed.
contrastive.letter_f: Like the f in fan ; same English friction.
contrastive.letter_g: Like g in go before a/o/u , and like g in gem before e/i .
contrastive.letter_h: Like the h in hat ; simple breathy sound.
contrastive.letter_i: Like the i in machine as a vowel, or like y in yes as a glide.
contrastive.letter_i_circumflex: Same sound family as â ; a central Romanian vowel with no direct English equivalent.
contrastive.letter_j: Like the s in measure or vision ; voiced and smooth.
contrastive.letter_k: Like the k in kite ; mainly in loanwords.
contrastive.letter_l: Like the l in leg ; clear, not darkened.
contrastive.letter_m: Like the m in map ; nasal and voiced.
contrastive.letter_n: Like the n in net ; nasal and direct.
contrastive.letter_o: Like the o in more , but usually shorter and cleaner.
contrastive.letter_p: Like the p in pen ; unvoiced and crisp.
contrastive.letter_r: Rolled or tapped r , closer to Spanish than English.
contrastive.letter_s: Like the s in sit ; unvoiced hissing sound.
contrastive.letter_s_cedilla: Like the sh in shoe ; Romanian uses the diacritic to mark this sound.
contrastive.letter_t: Like the t in top ; short and unvoiced.
contrastive.letter_t_cedilla: Like the ts in cats ; a clear affricate, not a plain English t.
contrastive.letter_u: Like the oo in boot ; rounded and steady.
contrastive.letter_v: Like the v in van ; voiced and familiar.
contrastive.letter_w: Used mostly in loanwords; usually like English w in wind .
contrastive.letter_x: Like x in box or x in exact , depending on position.
contrastive.letter_y: Mostly appears in loanwords; often sounds like y in yes .
contrastive.letter_z: Like the z in zoo ; voiced and sharp.
contrastive.letter_che-chi: /kʲ/ · Hard k followed by a front vowel glide · "cheie" (key), "chip" (face)
contrastive.letter_ghe-ghi: /ɡʲ/ · Hard g as in "get" before front vowels · "gheată" (boot), "ghiocel" (snowdrop)
contrastive.letter_ea: Approximate it as ye in yes , with a quick glide from e to a . · "stea" (star)
contrastive.letter_oa: Approximate it as wa in water , with a rounded opening toward a . · "soare" (sun)
contrastive.letter_ia: Approximate it as ya in yard , starting with a light y -glide. · "iată" (behold)
contrastive.letter_ie: Approximate it as ye in yet , but keep the glide short and fluid. · "ierburi" (herbs)
contrastive.letter_io: Approximate it as yo in yolk , with a brief initial glide before the vowel. · "milion" (million)
contrastive.letter_iu: Approximate it as yu in you , with a smooth movement toward u . · "chiu"
contrastive.letter_ua: Approximate it as wa in watt , shifting gently from u to a . · "rouă" (dew)
contrastive.letter_ue: Approximate it as we in wet , keeping the glide light and unstressed. · "rouă" (unstressed variants)
contrastive.letter_ai: Approximate it as the eye sound in high , with a clear closing glide. · "mai" (may)
contrastive.letter_ei: Approximate it as ay in day , with a smooth rise toward i . · "lei" (lions/money)
contrastive.letter_oi: Approximate it as oy in boy , with a rounded ending. · "doi" (two)
contrastive.letter_ui: Approximate it as a shortened oo-ee glide, similar to a fast transition into i . · "pui" (chicken)
contrastive.letter_au: Approximate it as ow in cow , with a wide opening from a to u . · "taur" (bull)
contrastive.letter_eu: Approximate it as a quick eh-oo glide, moving cleanly from e toward u . · "zeu" (god)
contrastive.letter_eai: Approximate it as a rapid yeye glide: e shifts through a into i . · "băteai" (you were beating)
contrastive.letter_iai: Approximate it as a quick yeye movement, with the opening glide kept very short. · "tăiai" (you were cutting)
contrastive.letter_eau: Approximate it as yow , a continuous glide from e toward a and ending in u . · "stăteau" (they were staying)
contrastive.letter_iau: Approximate it as eeow , but with a tighter start that moves quickly into the rounded ending. · "tăiau" (they were cutting)
contrastive.letter_ioa: Approximate it as ywa , with a brief glide into a broad final vowel. · "aripioare" (little wings)
